name: pi
summary: Computes digits of pi as compute jobs on the hosts of the mesh (BBP, then decimal conversion)

messages.name: start
messages.summary: Starts: chunks of digits go out as compute jobs to hosts with free slots

messages.name: status
messages.summary: Progress, and the digits computed so far

fields.name: chunk_timeout_ms
fields.doc: Wall time of a chunk's job (0: the host's default); a failed chunk goes out again

fields.name: work_ms
fields.doc: Each job takes at least this long (demonstrations)

fields.name: decimal
fields.doc: Convert to decimal digits at the end

fields.name: output_root
fields.doc: Root to write the digits to (empty: keep them in memory)

fields.name: hosts
fields.doc: Where the jobs run: ["any"] for hosts with free slots, [] for this host, or host names
